name: io.github.kirillradchenko96/fresh402
title: Fresh402 Agent Intelligence
description: Four web/API/Base workflows. 11 paid MCP/REST tools. Base/Solana USDC via x402/MPP. Prepaid.

tools.name: fresh402_register
tools.description: Observes public content without modifying its source. Adds a Fresh402 baseline and uses free registration capacity for new watches; never charges USDC or credits. Use free ($0) Register to save a public HTTPS baseline; no trial key, wallet or payment. Required url plus optional content/attribute rules identifies the watch. Save returned watch_id/hash for Check, Smart Diff or OpenAPI Contract Diff. When flagship workflows are advertised, compatible Website/API workflows accept source_watch_id to adopt this public baseline with its exact rules/time for one separately authorized comparison; it grants no private ownership and performs no extra baseline fetch. Same URL/rules returns existing state without fetching or refreshing; different rules identify another watch. It is not continuous monitoring. HTML/JSON/text only; no JavaScript, private or authenticated targets. DNS/fetch/quota limits apply, including on repeat calls. For walletless first Check inspect root instant_evaluation.enabled and set evaluation:true; separate /v3/agent-trial requires ownership signing. Connection grants no signing or payment authority.

url.description: Required absolute public HTTPS document URL, at most 4096 characters, e.g. 'https://example.com/docs'. Only port 443; no embedded credentials, private/local targets or authenticated pages. Fresh402's own service URLs, including its discovery /openapi.json, cannot be targets; choose an external public document. HTML, JSON and plain text are supported; JavaScript is not executed. DNS, redirect and size limits also apply.

selector.description: Optional HTML scope: a supported CSS selector, 1-256 characters, e.g. 'main' or 'article .content'. Only matching text is normalized; no match returns 422. Omit to normalize the page after built-in noise removal. Not supported for JSON or plain text.

ignore_selectors.description: Optional array of up to 20 CSS selectors (each 1-256 characters) to remove from HTML in addition to built-in noise filtering. Default: no extra exclusions ([]). HTML only; use ignore_json_paths for JSON. Example: ['.timestamp', '.ad'].

items.description: HTML element(s) to remove before normalization: a supported CSS selector, 1-256 characters, e.g. '.timestamp' or 'nav'.

ignore_json_paths.description: Optional array of up to 20 JSON Pointer-style paths to remove before JSON normalization and hashing. Each must start with '/' and be 1-256 characters; supports '*' segments. Default: [] (no exclusions). JSON only. Example: ['/updated_at', '/items/*/request_id'].

items.description: JSON Pointer-style path, 1-256 characters, starting with '/'. Decode '~0' as '~' and '~1' as '/'; '*' matches all object keys or array elements. Example: '/items/*/updated_at'.

html_attributes.description: Optional HTML-only watch rule: up to4 of href,title,alt,aria-label; default[] retains existing text-only normalization. Distinct names are sorted; nonempty rules create a separate version1 watch/baseline. Records bounded meaningful attributes within the saved selector or filtered page, including same-text link destination changes. Cannot be supplied with watch_id, even[]. Unsafe hrefs are hashed, never fetched. Limits:200 elements,2048 characters/value,32768 evidence bytes; excess fails, never clips silently.

items.description: One explicitly observed HTML attribute: href (a/area only),title,alt or aria-label. No class/style/event attributes; links are inert evidence and never fetched.

inputSchema.description: Register a free baseline using a required URL and optional content rules. The canonical URL plus rules identify the watch; changing rules creates a different watch. Repeating the same registration returns its existing watch_id/hash without fetching or refreshing it. Quotas apply. Reuse the returned watch_id in Check, Smart Diff or OpenAPI Contract Diff.

tools.name: fresh402_check
tools.description: Observes public documents without modifying their source. Execution can charge USDC or prepaid credits, consume trial quota and update Fresh402 records. A new charge requires prior spending authorization. Without billing/trial credentials and with evaluation:true omitted, a valid call returns an unpaid quote without executing the observation. Use Check for on-demand changed/unchanged, hash, cache status and optional text diff across sessions. Exactly one url or real watch_id; URL/rules can create a watch, while watch_id reuses rules and forbids overrides. Save returned ID/hash. First URL observation may return changed:null. max_age_seconds defaults0 (conditional revalidation); positive age permits cached evidence. html_attributes observes selected same-text attribute changes. Public HTTPS, no JavaScript or scheduler. Use Smart Diff for structured changes; when advertised, Website Change Intelligence combines observation and supported evidence in one charge. Walletless first Check: require root instant_evaluation.enabled, then set evaluation:true with valid URL/watch input. One attempt per verified network prefix per approved period, sharing finite capacity; no wallet, key, custom header or proprietary SDK. Exact replay returns retained evidence, not a new fetch;429 never authorizes payment. $0.005 USDC/call on Base (eip155:8453), including cache hits. Needs an x402-capable MCP payment client and funded native-USDC payer; ordinary MCP returns a payment challenge. Optional MPP (root mpp_payments.enabled): mppx, org.paymentauth/credential. Prepaid: X-Fresh402-API-Key plus params._meta["fresh402/prepaid"] {idempotency_key,tariff_version,max_credits}; inspect authenticated quote. Choose one billing method; never auto-pay. Persist original proof/input/private recovery token; recover originals after uncertainty. Circle only if root circle_gateway.enabled. Clients, limits and recovery: https://fresh402.com/docs#payments. Free signed trial: /v3/agent-trial requires an unfunded EOA ownership signature; human Web trial: /v2/trial. Eligibility/capacity may return429. Use only X-Fresh402-Trial-Key plus persisted Idempotency-Key; replay exact tool/input/key. Exhaustion never authorizes a charge. The same fixed x402 service price may also be paid in native Circle USDC on Solana Mainnet (solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp), when advertised by the unpaid challenge. Explicitly select one accepted network and pin its mint, merchant, amount and sponsored fee payer before signing. Solana payers need no Base wallet; Standalone native Solana MPP solana/charge is also advertised; its client pays a separately authorized SOL network fee, with no server fee sponsorship. Prepaid MPP funding remains Base-only. Payment network does not change the observed chain: blockchain products still inspect finalized Base. Solana delivery requires finalized matching USDC evidence. Persist the original network, resource, input, proof and private recovery capability; never switch networks or authorize a replacement after uncertainty.

evaluation.description: Optional, default false. Set true to request one walletless Check attempt per verified network prefix during the current approved evaluation period. No wallet, API key or payment header is needed. Shared capacity and source limits apply; repeat the identical input to recover its retained result. A network is not a unique agent. Never combine true with paid/prepaid/trial credentials. False or omission keeps normal paid behavior. Inspect live availability before requesting evaluation.

url.description: Supply exactly one of url or watch_id. URL must be absolute public HTTPS on port 443, at most 4096 characters, with no credentials/private targets, e.g. 'https://example.com/docs'. Fresh402's own service URLs, including its discovery /openapi.json, cannot be targets; choose an external public document. With url, optional content rules identify the watch; an existing watch is reused or a new one is created by this paid Check. Separate registration is not required. No JavaScript rendering.

watch_id.description: Supply exactly one of watch_id or url. An existing ID returned by fresh402_register (free), POST /v1/register, or a URL-based Check: 'w_' followed by 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Reuses that watch's stored URL and rules. When supplied, omit selector, ignore_selectors and ignore_json_paths entirely, even empty arrays. Do not invent an ID.

selector.description: Optional HTML CSS scope, 1-256 characters, e.g. 'main'; accepted only with url. Omit for the page after built-in noise removal. No match returns 422; not supported for JSON/plain text. With watch_id, omit this field: the saved selector is reused.

ignore_selectors.description: Optional HTML-only exclusion array, up to 20 supported CSS selectors of 1-256 characters each, e.g. ['.timestamp']. Accepted only with url; default []. With watch_id, omit the field entirely (including []): saved exclusions are reused.

items.description: HTML element(s) to remove before normalization: a supported CSS selector, 1-256 characters, e.g. '.timestamp' or 'nav'.

ignore_json_paths.description: Optional JSON-only exclusions, up to 20 paths of 1-256 characters starting with '/'; '~0'/'~1' escapes and '*' segments are supported. Example: ['/updated_at']. Accepted only with url; default []. With watch_id, omit entirely (including []): saved paths are reused.

items.description: JSON Pointer-style path, 1-256 characters, starting with '/'. Decode '~0' as '~' and '~1' as '/'; '*' matches all object keys or array elements. Example: '/items/*/updated_at'.

html_attributes.description: Optional HTML-only watch rule: up to4 of href,title,alt,aria-label; default[] retains existing text-only normalization. Distinct names are sorted; nonempty rules create a separate version1 watch/baseline. Records bounded meaningful attributes within the saved selector or filtered page, including same-text link destination changes. Cannot be supplied with watch_id, even[]. Unsafe hrefs are hashed, never fetched. Limits:200 elements,2048 characters/value,32768 evidence bytes; excess fails, never clips silently.

items.description: One explicitly observed HTML attribute: href (a/area only),title,alt or aria-label. No class/style/event attributes; links are inert evidence and never fetched.

previous_hash.description: Optional previous Fresh402 content hash: exactly 64 hexadecimal characters, case-insensitive. Overrides comparison with the watch's current stored hash. Omit to use that stored hash; a new URL watch without a prior hash returns changed:null. Hash comparison does not require retained old text, but a text diff does; a hash cannot reconstruct missing content.

max_age_seconds.description: Optional integer cache age in seconds, 0-86400; runtime default: 0. A positive value permits reuse of a sufficiently recent watch result without fetching. Zero contacts the source (conditional HTTP may return 304). Cached Checks still require payment; this does not schedule background polling.

include_diff.description: Optional boolean; runtime default: true. Request a compact deterministic text diff when content changed and compatible prior text is retained. False omits the diff; true cannot recover unavailable old content and does not enable Smart Diff's structural analysis.

inputSchema.description: Paid Check input: exactly one of url or watch_id is required. Content rules are allowed only on the url path; watch_id always reuses saved rules. Optional previous_hash overrides the reference hash; max_age_seconds controls cache reuse and include_diff controls text-diff output.

name.description: Unique output property name, 1-48 ASCII letters/digits/underscores, starting with a letter.

pointer.description: Exact RFC6901 JSON Pointer after exclusions; empty string selects root, ~0/~1 escape ~ and /. No wildcards, inference or linked-source fetching.

type.description: Required exact JSON value type. No string-to-number coercion; integer requires a safe integer. object excludes arrays/null.

required.description: Default true. A missing required value makes complete:false; optional missing values are still reported. No invented default or placeholder value.

items.description: One named typed field: exact source pointer, accepted JSON type and explicit requiredness. Missing/type-mismatched/over-budget values are reported, never invented or coerced.

fields.description: Optional 1-12 named typed fields for JSON sources only, exclusive with json_pointer/json_pointers/feed_mode. Every name must be distinct across the array, even when pointers or types differ; this runtime rule is stricter than whole-object uniqueItems. Uses one existing fetch/parse after ignore_json_paths. Missing/type-mismatched fields are reported individually, never silently coerced. Each selected value <=4,096 UTF-8 bytes; total values <=16,384 bytes/2,000 nodes. Over-budget fields are omitted explicitly. HTML/text retain ordinary extraction; no semantic or browser extraction.

source.description: Select already parsed JSON after ignore_json_paths; no additional fetch or parse.

pointer.description: Required exact RFC6901 pointer selecting an array after exclusions; empty string selects root. At most256 characters/64 segments, ~0/~1 escaping, no wildcard. Each field pointer is relative to an individual array item.

name.description: Unique output property name, 1-48 ASCII letters/digits/underscores, starting with a letter.

pointer.description: Exact RFC6901 JSON Pointer after exclusions; empty string selects root, ~0/~1 escape ~ and /. No wildcards, inference or linked-source fetching.

type.description: Required exact JSON value type. No string-to-number coercion; integer requires a safe integer. object excludes arrays/null.

required.description: Default true. A missing required value makes complete:false; optional missing values are still reported. No invented default or placeholder value.

items.description: One named typed field: exact source pointer, accepted JSON type and explicit requiredness. Missing/type-mismatched/over-budget values are reported, never invented or coerced.

fields.description: Required 1-12 distinct named typed fields. Each exact RFC6901 pointer is relative to a single selected array item. Required defaults true; no coercion. One shared 16,384-byte/2,000-node value budget across all records.

limit.description: Maximum returned records, 1-25, default20. Excess records are counted as omitted; no automatic pagination, crawling or larger output budget. A shared16,384 selected-value byte/2,000-node budget applies across every record.

source.description: Select static HTML after the same normal exclusions and scope as ordinary Extract; JavaScript is never run.

row_selector.description: Required selector for repeated record elements, e.g. .product or tbody tr. No comma groups/:scope. Nested matching records and table rowspan/colspan other than1 are unsupported, never silently flattened.

name.description: Unique output property name, 1-48 ASCII letters/digits/underscores, starting with a letter.

type.description: Required exact JSON value type. No string-to-number coercion; integer requires a safe integer. object excludes arrays/null.

required.description: Default true. A missing required value makes complete:false; optional missing values are still reported. No invented default or placeholder value.

selector.description: One supported CSS selector, 1-256 characters, without comma groups or :scope. Matches static descendants only; no XPath, scripts, browser layout or linked-source fetching. Example: td:nth-child(2).

attribute.description: Optional explicitly selected inert attribute. Allowed: href/src/alt/title/content/value/aria-label or data-* (1-48 lowercase letters/digits/underscores/hyphens). Omit for normalized descendant text. URLs are returned as untrusted strings, never fetched.

items.description: One named HTML field within each record. Exactly one matching descendant is required for a value; multiple matches are ambiguous, missing attributes/text nodes are not invented. The explicit type parses only an exact JSON scalar/object/array literal for non-string types; no currency stripping or locale coercion.

fields.description: 1-12 fields with distinct names. CSS selectors are relative descendant queries inside a record. String types return normalized text; other types require exact JSON literals and existing safe-integer/finite-number validation. Required defaults true; unsupported features are rejected.

limit.description: Maximum returned records, 1-25, default20. Excess records are counted as omitted; no automatic pagination, crawling or larger output budget. A shared16,384 selected-value byte/2,000-node budget applies across every record.

records.description: Optional bounded repeated-record extraction, exclusive with fields/json_pointer/json_pointers/feed_mode. JSON arrays or static HTML records/tables only, one original source fetch. Up to25 records and12 fields, globally16,384 selected-value bytes/2,000nodes. Every field has a source reference and explicit missing/invalid/ambiguous/truncated/unsupported status. No inferred table headers, currency conversion, browser, linked-page crawl or semantic model.

url.description: Required absolute public HTTPS document URL, at most 4096 characters, e.g. 'https://example.com/docs'. Only port 443; no embedded credentials, private/local targets or authenticated pages. Fresh402's own service URLs, including its discovery /openapi.json, cannot be targets; choose an external public document. HTML, JSON and plain text are supported; JavaScript is not executed. DNS, redirect and size limits also apply.

selector.description: Optional HTML CSS scope, 1-256 characters, e.g. 'article'. If omitted, choose main, then article, then body, then the document. Explicit scope must match (otherwise 422). Built-in noise and ignore_selectors are removed. Not supported for JSON/plain text.

ignore_selectors.description: Optional array of up to 20 CSS selectors (each 1-256 characters) to remove from HTML in addition to built-in noise filtering. Default: no extra exclusions ([]). HTML only; use ignore_json_paths for JSON. Example: ['.timestamp', '.ad'].

items.description: HTML element(s) to remove before normalization: a supported CSS selector, 1-256 characters, e.g. '.timestamp' or 'nav'.

ignore_json_paths.description: Optional array of up to 20 JSON Pointer-style paths to remove before JSON normalization and hashing. Each must start with '/' and be 1-256 characters; supports '*' segments. Default: [] (no exclusions). JSON only. Example: ['/updated_at', '/items/*/request_id'].

items.description: JSON Pointer-style path, 1-256 characters, starting with '/'. Decode '~0' as '~' and '~1' as '/'; '*' matches all object keys or array elements. Example: '/items/*/updated_at'.

feed_mode.description: Optional RSS2/Atom projection: 'entries'. Omit for unchanged XML-as-text extraction and existing hashes. Accepts XML/+xml/text/plain with an RSS2 root or namespaced Atom feed; no RSS1/RDF, HTML repair, DTD or external entity/content fetching. Cannot combine with CSS/JSON selection or exclusions. Limits:262144 UTF-8 source bytes,4096 XML elements,depth32,100 entries,16384 characters/field,131072 projected bytes; excess fails explicitly. Returns feed identity, inert declared links, entry IDs/timestamps/content fingerprints and indexed source evidence. Identical duplicate entries deduplicate; conflicting IDs fail422. Feed text/hash cover the canonical projection; max_chars clips text and omits structured feed when clipped. Existing registration/watch semantics remain unchanged.

json_pointer.description: Optional exact RFC 6901 JSON Pointer, at most 256 characters, e.g. '/product/price' or '/items/0/name'. JSON documents only; '~0' means '~' and '~1' means '/'. Empty string selects the whole document. Omit to extract the entire normalized document. Selection runs after ignore_json_paths; a missing or excluded target returns 422. Array indices are zero-based canonical integers; '*' is a literal key, not a wildcard. Returned text/data/hash cover the selected value; max_chars and data_omitted still apply.

json_pointers.description: Optional ordered1-8 unique exact JSON Pointers; mutually exclusive with json_pointer, JSON only. One fetch and JSON parse; exclusions run first. Any missing/excluded field fails the whole operation with422; null is a valid value. Returns data:[{pointer,value},...] and canonical aggregate text/hash. max_chars clips the aggregate; clipped data is omitted. Combined projection limited to200000 UTF-8 bytes and20000 nodes. Example:['/product/price','/product/stock'].

items.description: One exact RFC6901 pointer: up to256 characters/64 segments; '' selects root, '/' the empty key, '~0'/'~1' escape '~'/'/'. Example:'/product/price'; '*' is literal.

max_chars.description: Optional integer limit on returned normalized text: 100-50000 characters, default 20000. Does not raise fetch/parser limits; the hash covers full normalized text before truncation. If JSON text is truncated, parsed data is omitted (data:null, data_omitted:true).

include_links.description: Optional boolean, default true. Include bounded public links extracted from HTML. False returns an empty links array without changing normalized text or its hash. Does not crawl linked pages; JSON/plain text do not provide HTML links.

include_structured_data.description: Optional boolean, default true. Include embedded JSON-LD extracted from HTML in structured_data. False returns an empty structured_data array. This does not control the parsed data field for a JSON document, and does not fetch external linked data.

inputSchema.description: Extract a required public URL without creating or requiring a watch. Optional content rules scope/remove noise; max_chars limits returned text and the two include flags control supplementary HTML data. Opt-in feed_mode:'entries' projects bounded RSS2/Atom; omit to preserve original extraction. Unknown fields are rejected.

compare_to.description: Optional comparison mode: 'previous' (default) uses the latest Smart Diff snapshot, falling back to the current registered watch state on the first call. 'baseline' uses the fixed Smart Diff baseline, initially seeded from the earliest retained compatible watch snapshot. previous_hash overrides either mode. previous_hash.description: Optional explicit reference hash: 64 hexadecimal characters, case-insensitive, from this same watch's retained Smart Diff snapshot, fixed baseline or retained registration/Check snapshot. json_array_keys.description: Optional1-4 explicit nonoverlapping JSON array identity rules, JSON only. Omit for existing index comparison. At most2000 combined array items/20000 comparison work units, no fallback for ambiguity. Rules affect this comparison only, not the watch/hash; persist identical input for payment recovery. Example:[{path:'/items',key:'/id'}].

path.description: Exact RFC6901 pointer to an array on both compared JSON documents, up to256 characters/64 segments. Empty string selects a root array. Example:'/items'; no wildcards or automatic ID guessing.

key.description: Nonempty exact RFC6901 pointer within each object item, up to256 characters/64 segments; e.g.'/id' or '/product/sku'. Every key must exist and be a unique nonempty string<=256 characters or safe integer; number1 differs from string'1'.

items.description: Explicit JSON array identity rule. Both paths must resolve; missing/duplicate/invalid identities fail422 without index fallback. Source snapshot ordering/hash is retained.

inputSchema.description: Compare a required existing watch against previous or baseline (default previous), or use previous_hash to override the mode. Fetches the current source using saved rules; no cache-age option. Truncated or incompatible legacy baselines can return 409; legacy HTML may have text-only fidelity. Unknown fields are rejected.

json_array_keys.description: Optional bounded explicit JSON record identities for the website/JSON component only; not API or chain data. Same validation as Smart Diff; omit for index comparison. Comparison policy does not alter source ownership, saved hashes or paid recovery identity.

path.description: Exact RFC6901 pointer to an array on both compared JSON documents, up to256 characters/64 segments. Empty string selects a root array. Example:'/items'; no wildcards or automatic ID guessing.

key.description: Nonempty exact RFC6901 pointer within each object item, up to256 characters/64 segments; e.g.'/id' or '/product/sku'. Every key must exist and be a unique nonempty string<=256 characters or safe integer; number1 differs from string'1'.

items.description: Explicit JSON array identity rule. Both paths must resolve; missing/duplicate/invalid identities fail422 without index fallback. Source snapshot ordering/hash is retained.

selector.description: Optional HTML scope: a supported CSS selector, 1-256 characters, e.g. 'main' or 'article .content'. Only matching text is normalized; no match returns 422. Omit to normalize the page after built-in noise removal. Not supported for JSON or plain text.

ignore_selectors.description: Optional array of up to 20 CSS selectors (each 1-256 characters) to remove from HTML in addition to built-in noise filtering. Default: no extra exclusions ([]). HTML only; use ignore_json_paths for JSON. Example: ['.timestamp', '.ad'].

items.description: HTML element(s) to remove before normalization: a supported CSS selector, 1-256 characters, e.g. '.timestamp' or 'nav'.

ignore_json_paths.description: Optional array of up to 20 JSON Pointer-style paths to remove before JSON normalization and hashing. Each must start with '/' and be 1-256 characters; supports '*' segments. Default: [] (no exclusions). JSON only. Example: ['/updated_at', '/items/*/request_id'].

items.description: JSON Pointer-style path, 1-256 characters, starting with '/'. Decode '~0' as '~' and '~1' as '/'; '*' matches all object keys or array elements. Example: '/items/*/updated_at'.

html_attributes.description: For workflow HTML, default is all four supported attributes: href,title,alt,aria-label. Explicit [] requests text-only comparison and is reported as limited scope. Ignored selectors apply to both text and attribute evidence. Not applied to JSON/text.

items.description: One explicitly observed HTML attribute: href (a/area only),title,alt or aria-label. No class/style/event attributes; links are inert evidence and never fetched.

scope.description: Immutable supported normalization rules. Selected attributes participate in change detection; ignored fields are outside the reported scope. No browser execution or linked-page crawling.

api_url.description: Optional explicit JSON OpenAPI source for a new cross-domain identity; no link discovery. Saved observation_id freezes this URL too. source_watch_id adopts only the website; this API source seeds separately.

onchain.description: Required with url or source_watch_id for a new cross-domain identity. One narrow finalized Base brief; its addresses become immutable and share one existing 18-RPC reservation.

chain_id.description: Base mainnet only; provider chain is verified. All state is pinned to one selected finalized block.

contract_address.description: One selected contract which is also the token-facts and Transfer-log contract. The workflow does not infer that arbitrary bytecode is a safe or compliant token.

wallet_address.description: One selected wallet. Returns its exact native-ETH balance and this contract's provider-reported Transfer events at the single selected finalized block, not complete wallet history.

release_label.description: Claimed release identifier. Exact source mentions are evidence only, never authentication, deployment proof or causality. May change between observations without changing source identity.
